Wizard.startOverConfirm: Are you sure you want to start over? This will clear all your current progress and cannot be undone.
Wizard.basicInfoDesc: Provide basic information about the agent and company.
Wizard.languagesHint: Select one or more languages. At least one language must be selected.
Wizard.styleDesc: Configure the communication style and tone of the agent.
Wizard.empathyHint: How empathetic and understanding the agent should be (0-10)
Wizard.depthHint: How detailed and thorough responses should be (0-10)
Wizard.examplesDesc: Provide examples of how you want the agent to communicate. These examples will guide the agent's style and tone. Examples should be in English, but the agent will respond in the user's language.
Wizard.standardExamplesHint: These are common questions customers ask. You can edit them to match your preferred style.
Wizard.customExamplesHint: Add your own examples to demonstrate specific communication scenarios. Maximum 4 custom examples.
Wizard.addCustomExampleHint: Click "Add Custom Example" to add your own communication examples.
Wizard.examplesTip: These examples demonstrate the desired communication style. The agent will learn from these examples to match your preferred tone, formality level, and response style. Make sure examples reflect the style settings you configured in the previous step.
Wizard.ragDesc: Enable RAG to provide context-aware responses based on documents about the agent and company.
Wizard.ragDescription: Retrieval-Augmented Generation allows the agent to use your documents for context-aware responses.
Wizard.visionModelHint: Used for describing images in your knowledge base and for images users send in chat. Default is Gemini 3.1 Pro (Preview) unless a different model is set in the agent config.
Wizard.visionModelPreviewNote: Preview models may change; billing and rate limits follow Google AI Studio. See Google documentation for availability.
Wizard.manageDocumentsHint: — upload files, organize in folders (PDF, txt, md, json, images).
Wizard.ragAfterCreate: After creating the agent, you'll add documents on the RAG page — folders, PDFs, images.
Wizard.ragTopKHint: How many document chunks to include (1–50). Lower values reduce prompt size and API cost.
Wizard.ragScoreThresholdHint: Minimum similarity score (0–1). Higher = stricter matching, fewer chunks; lower = more context.
Wizard.escalationDesc: Configure when the agent should hand off a conversation to a human operator.
Wizard.escalationLlmEnabledHint: When off, the backend skips the escalation classifier before replies — no auto handoff from custom or contact rules. Content moderation still runs.
Wizard.contactDetectionHint: Escalate automatically when the user shares a phone number or email address.
Wizard.addRuleHint: Add rules to define additional escalation scenarios specific to your business.
Wizard.descriptionPlaceholder: e.g. When the user expresses strong dissatisfaction or files a complaint — transfer to a human immediately.
Wizard.descriptionHelper: Describe the situation and what the agent should do.
Wizard.llmDesc: Configure the language model parameters for agent responses.
Wizard.temperatureHint: Controls randomness (0 = deterministic, 2 = very creative). Recommended: 0.2 for consistent responses.
Wizard.maxTokensHelper: Maximum length of generated responses (1–4096 tokens)
Wizard.moderationSectionDesc: Choose how user and agent messages are checked. OpenAI uses the dedicated Moderations API. Google uses a Gemini JSON classifier — behaviour differs from OpenAI and requires GOOGLE_AI_STUDIO_API.
Wizard.moderationGeminiHint: Gemini moderation is a separate JSON classifier, not identical to OpenAI Moderation API categories.
Wizard.moderationEnabledHint: When off, the Moderations API is not called — fewer false positives on everyday or clinical wording. Trade-off: no automatic toxic-content filter.
Wizard.reviewDesc: Review your agent configuration before creating.
Wizard.reviewUpdateDesc: Review your agent configuration before updating.
Wizard.reviewEscalationLlmHint: When set to No, the backend skips the escalation classifier before replies. Confirm "escalation.enabled": false in the JSON tab if you need full control.
Wizard.reviewModerationSeparateNote: Content moderation is separate: it may still hand off conversations when policy requires, even if LLM escalation is off.
Wizard.jsonEditorHint: You can edit the JSON configuration directly. Changes will be applied when you create the agent.
Wizard.promptsHint: Customize the system prompts that guide the agent's behaviour. Leave blank to use the default templates. Available placeholders: {'{agent_display_name}'}, {'{company_display_name}'}.
Wizard.personaHelper: How the agent presents itself — its identity, tone, and role.
Wizard.hardRulesHelper: Absolute boundaries — what the agent must never do, regardless of context.
Wizard.goalHelper: The agent's primary objective — what success looks like in each conversation.
Wizard.agentIdRequired: Agent ID is required. Please fill in the company name.

instagram.needItem2: A Facebook Page connected to your Instagram
instagram.needItem3: An Instagram Professional or Business account
instagram.intro: This setup tells Instagram to send incoming messages to this assistant. Production DMs require Meta App Review with Advanced Access for instagram_manage_messages.
instagram.appReviewNote: App Review: production Instagram DMs need Advanced Access. Development mode only delivers messages from app roles (admins, developers, testers).
instagram.step1: Go to Meta Developers and create a new app. When asked for the type, choose Business. You can reuse an existing Meta app.
instagram.step2: Inside your app, add the Instagram product. Then go to Instagram → Webhooks and subscribe to messages.
instagram.step3Help: Meta will ask for two values. Copy them from here and paste into Meta Console:
instagram.verifyTokenSameValue: Use this same value in the Meta Console “Verify Token” field.
instagram.verifyAfterSave: After you enter both values in Meta Console and click Verify and Save, Meta sends a test request — it responds automatically.
instagram.step4: Get a Page Access Token (not a User token) so the assistant can reply. In Graph API Explorer generate a Page token with instagram_manage_messages and pages_manage_metadata. Copy your Instagram Account ID from Meta Business Suite → Settings → Instagram Accounts.
instagram.step5: Enter the Account ID and Page Access Token below, then click Connect. The connection is verified automatically.

Legal.privacyDraft: This page is the product privacy policy for Service ChatBot. It describes how this product processes data. It is a working draft and is not a substitute for independent legal advice.
Legal.termsDraft: This page is the product terms of service for Service ChatBot. It is a working draft for operators and reviewers and is not a substitute for independent legal advice.
Legal.whoWeAreBody: Service ChatBot is a web application that lets service businesses create an AI chatbot and connect it to messengers such as Telegram, Viber, Instagram, and TikTok. The product is operated by the organization that deploys this instance.
Legal.whoUsesBody: Operators are the people who sign in to the admin dashboard to create agents, connect channels, and handle conversations. End users are the customers or visitors who message those agents on a connected messenger. This policy covers both groups.
Legal.dataBody: For operators we process account identifiers such as email, login session data, agent configuration, knowledge-base documents you upload, and channel connection details including tokens needed to send and receive messages. For end users we process messages, channel identifiers (for example a messenger user id or open_id), optional profile fields provided by the channel, and conversation metadata such as status and CRM stage. We process this data to run the chatbot, show an inbox to operators, and keep the service reliable.
Legal.cookiesBody: We use a language preference cookie and a session cookie (or equivalent) so that operators stay signed in and see the admin interface in their chosen language. These are necessary for the product to work. We do not use advertising cookies on the public pages.
Legal.thirdPartiesBody: When you connect a channel, we send and receive data through that provider. This includes TikTok Login Kit when an operator connects a TikTok account, as well as Telegram, Viber, and Instagram (Meta) when those channels are enabled. We also use language-model and hosting providers to generate replies and run the application. Those providers process data only to deliver the requested service.
Legal.contactBody: Questions about this product policy can be sent through the operator account used to sign in to Service ChatBot, or to the organization that operates this instance. If you are an end user, contact the business whose chatbot you messaged.
Legal.termsUseBody: By using Service ChatBot you agree to these terms. Operators must have the right to connect each messenger account, including TikTok via Login Kit. You must not misuse the product, attempt unauthorized access, or use it to send spam or unlawful content. Access may be suspended if these terms are broken.
Legal.termsChannelsBody: Channel providers (TikTok, Telegram, Viber, Instagram/Meta) have their own terms. Connecting an account through this product, including TikTok Login Kit, does not change those terms. Messaging on TikTok may remain unavailable until partner access is granted; a connection can still be saved as pending.
